dialogue.text: When people think of Valentine's Day, they think of love, blowers, chocolates, and cards with pictures of hearts.
dialogue.zh: 當人們想到情人節時，他們會想到愛、花朵、巧克力和印有愛心圖案的卡片。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインデーと言えば、愛や花、チョコレート、そしてハートの絵が描かれたカードを思い浮かべます。
dialogue.local: When people think of Valentine's Day, they think of love, blowers, chocolates, and cards with pictures of hearts.
dialogue.en: When people think of Valentine's Day, they think of love, blowers, chocolates, and cards with pictures of hearts.

dialogue.text: It's a fun way of celebrating the day of love, but do you know how Valentine's Day originated?
dialogue.zh: 這是一種有趣的慶祝愛的方式，但你知道情人節是怎麼來的嗎？
dialogue.ja: 愛の日を祝う楽しい方法ですが、バレンタインデーの起源をご存知ですか？
dialogue.local: It's a fun way of celebrating the day of love, but do you know how Valentine's Day originated?
dialogue.en: It's a fun way of celebrating the day of love, but do you know how Valentine's Day originated?

dialogue.text: Saint Valentine was a real man who lived in Roman times.
dialogue.zh: 聖瓦倫丁是一位生活在羅馬時代的真實人物。
dialogue.ja: 聖バレンタインは、ローマ時代に実在した人物です。
dialogue.local: Saint Valentine was a real man who lived in Roman times.
dialogue.en: Saint Valentine was a real man who lived in Roman times.

dialogue.text: Although the details of his life are unclear, it's believed that he was a Christian priest during the 3rd century CE.
dialogue.zh: 雖然他的生平細節不清楚，但人們相信他是公元三世紀的一位基督教牧師。
dialogue.ja: 彼の生涯の詳細は不明ですが、西暦3世紀のキリスト教の司祭だったと考えられています。
dialogue.local: Although the details of his life are unclear, it's believed that he was a Christian priest during the 3rd century CE.
dialogue.en: Although the details of his life are unclear, it's believed that he was a Christian priest during the 3rd century CE.

dialogue.text: That's about 1700 years ago.
dialogue.zh: 那大約是1700年前的事了。
dialogue.ja: それは約1700年前のことです。
dialogue.local: That's about 1700 years ago.
dialogue.en: That's about 1700 years ago.

dialogue.text: At the time, most people practiced paganism, which meant they believed in several gods.
dialogue.zh: 當時，大多數人信奉多神教，也就是相信多位神明。
dialogue.ja: 当時、多くの人々は多神教を信仰しており、複数の神々を信じていました。
dialogue.local: At the time, most people practiced paganism, which meant they believed in several gods.
dialogue.en: At the time, most people practiced paganism, which meant they believed in several gods.

dialogue.text: Christianity, or the belief in one god, was actually banned in Rome.
dialogue.zh: 基督教，也就是信仰唯一的神，在羅馬其實是被禁止的。
dialogue.ja: キリスト教、つまり唯一の神を信じる宗教は、ローマでは実際に禁止されていました。
dialogue.local: Christianity, or the belief in one god, was actually banned in Rome.
dialogue.en: Christianity, or the belief in one god, was actually banned in Rome.

dialogue.text: Valentine helped many Christians who were being persecuted, and he treated everybody with kindness, compassion, and empathy.
dialogue.zh: 瓦倫丁幫助了許多受迫害的基督徒，並以善良、同情和共感對待每一個人。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインは迫害されている多くのキリスト教徒を助け、誰に対しても親切で思いやりのある態度を示しました。
dialogue.local: Valentine helped many Christians who were being persecuted, and he treated everybody with kindness, compassion, and empathy.
dialogue.en: Valentine helped many Christians who were being persecuted, and he treated everybody with kindness, compassion, and empathy.

dialogue.text: The emperor at the time, Emperor Claudius, thought that single men were better soldiers than married men.
dialogue.zh: 當時的皇帝克勞狄烏斯認為，單身男子比已婚男子更適合當兵。
dialogue.ja: 当時の皇帝クラウディウスは、独身の男性の方が既婚者よりも優れた兵士だと考えていました。
dialogue.local: The emperor at the time, Emperor Claudius, thought that single men were better soldiers than married men.
dialogue.en: The emperor at the time, Emperor Claudius, thought that single men were better soldiers than married men.

dialogue.text: He claimed that married men loved their families too much, and were less willing to take risks and follow orders.
dialogue.zh: 他認為已婚男子太愛家人，不願冒險或服從命令。
dialogue.ja: 彼は、既婚者は家族を愛しすぎていて、リスクを取ったり命令に従ったりする意欲が低いと主張しました。
dialogue.local: He claimed that married men loved their families too much, and were less willing to take risks and follow orders.
dialogue.en: He claimed that married men loved their families too much, and were less willing to take risks and follow orders.

dialogue.text: The emperor decided to outlaw marriage for young men.
dialogue.zh: 皇帝決定禁止年輕男子結婚。
dialogue.ja: 皇帝は若い男性の結婚を禁止することに決めました。
dialogue.local: The emperor decided to outlaw marriage for young men.
dialogue.en: The emperor decided to outlaw marriage for young men.

dialogue.text: He wanted to make sure their loyalty would be to him, and not to their loved ones.
dialogue.zh: 他想確保他們的忠誠是對他，而不是對他們所愛的人。
dialogue.ja: 彼は、彼らの忠誠心が自分に向けられ、愛する人々に向けられないようにしたかったのです。
dialogue.local: He wanted to make sure their loyalty would be to him, and not to their loved ones.
dialogue.en: He wanted to make sure their loyalty would be to him, and not to their loved ones.

dialogue.text: Valentine thought that stopping people from getting married and raising families was unfair.
dialogue.zh: 瓦倫丁認為阻止人們結婚和組建家庭是不公平的。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインは、人々が結婚して家庭を築くことを妨げるのは不公平だと考えました。
dialogue.local: Valentine thought that stopping people from getting married and raising families was unfair.
dialogue.en: Valentine thought that stopping people from getting married and raising families was unfair.

dialogue.text: He defied the emperor's orders, and continued to perform marriages for young couples in secret.
dialogue.zh: 他違抗皇帝的命令，秘密為年輕情侶主持婚禮。
dialogue.ja: 彼は皇帝の命令に逆らい、若いカップルの結婚式を秘密裏に執り行い続けました。
dialogue.local: He defied the emperor's orders, and continued to perform marriages for young couples in secret.
dialogue.en: He defied the emperor's orders, and continued to perform marriages for young couples in secret.

dialogue.text: Helping Christians was a serious crime under Roman law, as was defying the emperor's ban on marriage.
dialogue.zh: 幫助基督徒和違抗皇帝禁止結婚的命令，在羅馬法律下都是嚴重的罪行。
dialogue.ja: キリスト教徒を助けることも、皇帝の結婚禁止令に逆らうことも、ローマ法では重罪でした。
dialogue.local: Helping Christians was a serious crime under Roman law, as was defying the emperor's ban on marriage.
dialogue.en: Helping Christians was a serious crime under Roman law, as was defying the emperor's ban on marriage.

dialogue.text: Valentine was caught and thrown in prison.
dialogue.zh: 瓦倫丁被抓住並投入監獄。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインは捕らえられ、投獄されました。
dialogue.local: Valentine was caught and thrown in prison.
dialogue.en: Valentine was caught and thrown in prison.

dialogue.text: While he was in prison, Valentine tried to convince the emperor to abandon paganism and accept Christianity.
dialogue.zh: 在監獄中，瓦倫丁試圖說服皇帝放棄多神教，接受基督教。
dialogue.ja: 投獄中、バレンタインは皇帝に多神教を捨ててキリスト教を受け入れるよう説得しようとしました。
dialogue.local: While he was in prison, Valentine tried to convince the emperor to abandon paganism and accept Christianity.
dialogue.en: While he was in prison, Valentine tried to convince the emperor to abandon paganism and accept Christianity.

dialogue.text: Claudius was enraged by this behavior, and he ordered Valentine to turn away from his faith, or be put to death.
dialogue.zh: 克勞狄烏斯對此行為非常憤怒，命令瓦倫丁放棄信仰，否則處死。
dialogue.ja: クラウディウスはこの行動に激怒し、バレンタインに信仰を捨てるよう命じ、従わなければ死刑にすると言いました。
dialogue.local: Claudius was enraged by this behavior, and he ordered Valentine to turn away from his faith, or be put to death.
dialogue.en: Claudius was enraged by this behavior, and he ordered Valentine to turn away from his faith, or be put to death.

dialogue.text: Valentine chose death over changing his beliefs, and so he was killed on February 14th, a day we now celebrate as Valentine's Day.
dialogue.zh: 瓦倫丁選擇為信仰犧牲生命，於是他在2月14日被處死，這一天就是我們現在慶祝的情人節。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインは信念を変えることよりも死を選び、2月14日に処刑されました。この日が現在のバレンタインデーです。
dialogue.local: Valentine chose death over changing his beliefs, and so he was killed on February 14th, a day we now celebrate as Valentine's Day.
dialogue.en: Valentine chose death over changing his beliefs, and so he was killed on February 14th, a day we now celebrate as Valentine's Day.

dialogue.text: This explains the name and the date of Valentine's Day, but what does it have to do with hearts, flowers, and chocolates?
dialogue.zh: 這解釋了情人節的名稱和日期，但它與心形、花朵和巧克力有什麼關係呢？
dialogue.ja: これでバレンタインデーの名前と日付の由来はわかりましたが、ハートや花、チョコレートとはどう関係があるのでしょうか？
dialogue.local: This explains the name and the date of Valentine's Day, but what does it have to do with hearts, flowers, and chocolates?
dialogue.en: This explains the name and the date of Valentine's Day, but what does it have to do with hearts, flowers, and chocolates?

dialogue.text: All of these things have been symbols of love for hundreds, maybe even thousands of years.
dialogue.zh: 這些東西作為愛的象徵已有數百年，甚至數千年的歷史。
dialogue.ja: これらはすべて、何百年、あるいは何千年もの間、愛の象徴とされてきました。
dialogue.local: All of these things have been symbols of love for hundreds, maybe even thousands of years.
dialogue.en: All of these things have been symbols of love for hundreds, maybe even thousands of years.

dialogue.text: Over the years, Valentine's Day became associated not just with St. Valentine, but also with the idea of love in general.
dialogue.zh: 多年來，情人節不僅與聖瓦倫丁有關，也與愛的概念息息相關。
dialogue.ja: 年月を経て、バレンタインデーは聖バレンタインだけでなく、愛という概念全般と結びつくようになりました。
dialogue.local: Over the years, Valentine's Day became associated not just with St. Valentine, but also with the idea of love in general.
dialogue.en: Over the years, Valentine's Day became associated not just with St. Valentine, but also with the idea of love in general.

dialogue.text: That's why, today, we often think of all these symbols of love on February 14th.
dialogue.zh: 這就是為什麼今天我們常在2月14日想到這些愛的象徵。
dialogue.ja: だからこそ、今日では2月14日にこれらすべての愛の象徴を思い浮かべるのです。
dialogue.local: That's why, today, we often think of all these symbols of love on February 14th.
dialogue.en: That's why, today, we often think of all these symbols of love on February 14th.

dialogue.text: Although Valentine's Day is often considered a celebration of romantic love, it's also about friendship and kindness.
dialogue.zh: 雖然情人節常被視為浪漫愛情的慶典，但它同時也關乎友誼與善意。
dialogue.ja: バレンタインデーはしばしば恋愛の祝日と考えられますが、友情や思いやりについても大切な日です。
dialogue.local: Although Valentine's Day is often considered a celebration of romantic love, it's also about friendship and kindness.
dialogue.en: Although Valentine's Day is often considered a celebration of romantic love, it's also about friendship and kindness.

dialogue.text: It's the perfect day to show love and appreciation to your family and friends.
dialogue.zh: 這是向家人和朋友表達愛與感謝的最佳日子。
dialogue.ja: 家族や友人に愛と感謝を伝えるのにぴったりの日です。
dialogue.local: It's the perfect day to show love and appreciation to your family and friends.
dialogue.en: It's the perfect day to show love and appreciation to your family and friends.

dialogue.text: You can celebrate Valentine's Day at school by making cards or friendship bracelets, and swapping them with your friends.
dialogue.zh: 你可以在學校製作卡片或友誼手環，並與朋友交換來慶祝情人節。
dialogue.ja: 学校でカードや友情のブレスレットを作って友達と交換し、バレンタインデーを祝うことができます。
dialogue.local: You can celebrate Valentine's Day at school by making cards or friendship bracelets, and swapping them with your friends.
dialogue.en: You can celebrate Valentine's Day at school by making cards or friendship bracelets, and swapping them with your friends.

dialogue.text: You can also share your toys, or you can simply see something nice to someone and make them feel good about themselves.
dialogue.zh: 你也可以分享玩具，或是對別人說些好話，讓他們感覺良好。
dialogue.ja: おもちゃを共有したり、誰かに優しい言葉をかけて気持ちを明るくすることもできます。
dialogue.local: You can also share your toys, or you can simply see something nice to someone and make them feel good about themselves.
dialogue.en: You can also share your toys, or you can simply see something nice to someone and make them feel good about themselves.

dialogue.text: Just as St. Valentine was kind to all, friendship and kindness should be shared with everyone, so that no classmate feels left out.
dialogue.zh: 正如聖瓦倫丁對所有人都很友善，友誼和善意也應該分享給每一個人，讓沒有人感到被排擠。
dialogue.ja: 聖バレンタインが皆に親切だったように、友情と思いやりはみんなに分け与えられるべきで、誰も仲間外れに感じないようにしましょう。
dialogue.local: Just as St. Valentine was kind to all, friendship and kindness should be shared with everyone, so that no classmate feels left out.
dialogue.en: Just as St. Valentine was kind to all, friendship and kindness should be shared with everyone, so that no classmate feels left out.

dialogue.text: How will you celebrate Valentine's Day?
dialogue.zh: 你打算怎麼慶祝情人節呢？
dialogue.ja: あなたはどのようにバレンタインデーを祝いますか？
dialogue.local: How will you celebrate Valentine's Day?
dialogue.en: How will you celebrate Valentine's Day?

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝大家。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.
